entries.name: home_background
entries.prompt: Create the BACKGROUND ONLY of the LEFT home screen in the reference: portrait 2:3 pixel-art sunlit castle courtyard, ivory castle on the RIGHT in middle distance, blue sky and clouds, stone ivy-covered column with royal blue/gold flag on LEFT, flowers and greenery, warm pale stone floor across lower third. entries.name: wide_blue_frame
entries.prompt: Production standalone game UI asset for FocusQuest. The supplied image is a TWO-SCREEN UI DESIGN REFERENCE, NOT an output to copy wholesale. Match its elegant royal deep navy blue, warm antique GOLD, subtle blue woven floral texture, thin double gold outlines and delicate pointed leaf corner ornaments. Lightly pixel-art styled decorations consistent with the reference. No chunky simplified vector substitute. Absolutely NO letters, numbers, labels, characters, logos, UI screenshots or other panels. Only the requested SINGLE asset. Keep symmetrical centered blank areas suitable for dynamic text rendered separately in an app. ONE wide shallow rectangular empty navy panel FRAME, aspect ratio about 5:1, as used for the reference's home upper status card, time metrics strip and primary action button. Delicate gold edge ornaments and small centered diamond at top and bottom. OPAQUE deep navy texture inside, TRANSPARENT alpha outside, small even external padding. Blank navy center with NO icon or text. The border must be thin, not thick sculpted metal. Corners and edges clean for nine-slice scaling.

entries.prompt: ONE standalone subdued cyan-blue MAGIC COMPASS CIRCLE from the RIGHT reference's timer card. Exact sort of fine circular compass rose with delicate ticks and a four-point vertical/horizontal star. Subtle dark blue and cyan lines, low contrast, transparent alpha background. entries.name: home_stage
entries.prompt: Production BACKGROUND ONLY for FocusQuest HOME top character showcase. Faithfully recreate the scene in the LEFT reference around the standing hero, but NO character, NO UI, NO text. WIDE landscape 4:3 composition: blue sky and clouds, ornate ivory castle on RIGHT middle distance, blue/gold hanging flag and ivy stone column at LEFT, small white flowers and shrubs at edges. Warm pale stone courtyard FLOOR across bottom 18 percent, standing area at bottom CENTER LEFT open for separate existing illustration. Pixel-art background with crisp tiny square color clusters. The floor horizon must be at 80 percent image height so a hero composited over this landscape will visibly stand on the floor. Premium sunlit navy/gold/ivory castle world, not a flat cartoon. Single scenery image, no frames, no watermarks.
